title: Niko Borovyk — Shoemaker & Leather Restorer
hero: My name is Niko Borovyk. For 8 years, I have worked professionally in traditional shoemaking and premium leather care.

My path began with comprehensive training from an experienced master in the full cycle of handmade shoe production. Later, I gained extensive practical experience in leading restoration ateliers in Ukraine, solving complex technical challenges.
Today I develop my own workshop, Koko Recovery, while creating original footwear designs and taking on demanding commissions.
I speak Ukrainian, Russian, English, and Hungarian.
skillGroups: Moulding leather insoles on the last
Working with leather and rubber soles
Installing heel taps and protective soles
Leather dyeing with penetrating alcohol- and water-based dyes
Working with Saphir professional shoe care and comparable products
managementLead: Experience managing my own shoe workshop and organising the complete working process.
managementCards: Selecting leather, soles, hardware, and professional chemicals
Order follow-through from intake to delivery
masterLead: Part of my professional experience comes from working alongside a master with more than 30 years of handmade shoemaking experience. During this work, we completed high-responsibility commissions, including footwear for the Presidential family and the Vatican.
restorationLead: Extensive hands-on experience repairing and restoring shoes, bags, and leather accessories, including premium items.
restorationServices: Restoring an item's shape and construction
Installing protective soles and heel taps
Repairing and restoring leather bags and accessories
Dyeing, colour restoration, and colour matching
Careful work with valuable and technically demanding items
